IntelliDoc · User Guide

Installing and Managing IntelliDoc GitHub App Integration

Learn how to connect your GitHub repositories to IntelliDoc and automate documentation generation. This guide covers installing the GitHub App, configuring repositories, and managing documentation pull requests to keep your docs up to date.

60 steps~8 minIntelliDoc · GitHub

Sign in with GitHub

1

Navigate to the IntelliDoc website and click "Continue with GitHub".

2

Log in / select your GitHub account.

3

The app authenticates using GitHub OAuth.

4

A new user will see 0 accounts.

Install the GitHub App

5

Click "How to install the GitHub App" to add an account / repository.

6

Click "Install GitHub App".

7

Log in / select your GitHub account.

8

Click on the account "TF-Capstone-Project-Org".

9

Choose all repositories or select "Only select repositories".

10

Click "Select repositories".

11

Click "TF-Capstone-Project-Org/sandbox-clean" to select the repo.

12

Click "Install" to install the IntelliDoc app on the account.

13

Verify the "IntelliDoc Dev" app installation.

14

Reload the IntelliDoc website.

Manage accounts & repositories

15

The user can now see the added account.

16

Select the account "TF-Capstone-Project-Org".

17

The user can add more repos by clicking "Install GitHub App".

18

Click "Configure" next to TF-Capstone-Project-Org to manage the account.

19

Select the untracked repo "TF-Capstone-Project-Org/sandbox-messy".

20

Click "Save" to update repo tracking.

21

Reload the website — the user can see their tracked repos.

Baseline documentation

22

Click on a repository.

23

Baseline path: click "Regenerate docs" to generate the baseline documentation for the repo.

24

Click "View" to see the job's current status.

25

Click "⋮" and view the job logs.

26

View the job logs.

27

Click "View history" to view the doc PR history.

28

Click "#6" to open the PR.

29

Verify the doc PR content.

30

Review the generated documents.

31

Click "Merge pull request" to merge the PR into the main branch.

32

After the merge, an "update job" is created to sync details in IntelliDoc, and "Last documented SHA" is updated.

33

Job history shows the PR status.

Incremental documentation

34

Incremental path: merge a code-change PR into the main branch.

35

A new incremental job is created for the merged PR.

36

Wait for the job to complete.

37

View job history to see all PR statuses.

38

On the job, click "⋮" to view actions, then click "Open PR #7" to navigate to the doc PR.

39

Review the PR description.

40

Review the modified files.

41

Merge the doc PR.

42

After the merge, view the job logs.

43

A new entry appears for the PR merge.

44

Job history also shows the merge status for the PR.

45

The new SHA is updated in the system.

46

Job status refreshes every 5 seconds, and the user can see tokens consumed and approximate cost.

Audit log & tracked branch

47

View repo logs by clicking "Audit log".

48

The audit log shows consolidated job details with multiple filter options.

49

Update the tracked branch by typing a new branch name ("develop") and clicking "Update subscription".

50

This triggers a baseline doc generation job.

51

Click "View" to see the baseline job's current status.

52

Once the job completes, the new PR appears in job history.

Rejecting a doc PR

53

Click "Close pull request" to discard the PR.

54

The job log shows a new entry for the rejected PR.

55

Job history also shows the updated PR status.

Unsubscribe & re-subscribe

56

Stop tracking the repo by clicking "Unsubscribe".

57

IntelliDoc stops tracking the repo.

58

Re-subscribe the repo by clicking "Subscribe".

59

This triggers a baseline generation PR.

60

To cancel the job, click "⋮" and choose "Cancel job".
